hero.title: Read offers, see differences, share the decision.
hero.description: Versus AI compares insurance offers and policy files in one workspace, then turns them into controlled decision reports.

mode.label: Enterprise pilot
mode.value: For brokers, agencies, and insurance teams

story.title: When offer differences are hidden, decision quality drops.
story.description: When quotes, endorsements, and policy documents are evaluated together, teams do not need more content. They need a workspace that reads differences consistently and turns them into reliable decisions.

stack.title: Documents are grouped by case
stack.description: Quotes, clause lists, and renewal files are brought into one evaluation workspace.

noise.title: Critical differences are separated
noise.description: Deductible, limit, and coverage differences are lifted out of the document noise.

decision.title: A decision report is created
decision.description: Teams see why an offer stands out through the same standard.

reveal.title: VERSUS AI
reveal.description: It brings documents into one surface, exposes critical differences, and turns the evaluation output into a decision report.

media.title: Offer comparison and reasoned decision report
media.description: The demo video shows how Versus AI reads offers, classifies differences, and creates the decision output.

mobile_story.title: The mobile product flow is presented more simply.
mobile_story.description: Documents, critical differences, and decision output are shown in a compact evaluation flow.

capabilities.title: Versus AI standardizes offer evaluation.
capabilities.description: Instead of reading every quote one by one, you see differences, impacts, and decision rationale in one surface.

compare.title: Makes differences visible
compare.description: Collects coverage, limit, deductible, and exclusion differences across offers in one table.

explain.title: Explains the impact
explain.description: Summarizes each difference with insurance impact and carries the decision context, not raw data alone.

recommend.title: Shortens decision time
recommend.description: Helps teams evaluate the right offer faster, with more control and consistency.

how.title: Enterprise usage moves through three steps.
how.description: First, the real file type and decision need are defined; then the pilot workspace and live usage model are set up.

upload.title: Collect files in one case
upload.description: Upload quotes, policies, or renewal documents into one evaluation workspace.

analyze.title: Standardize the differences
analyze.description: The system reads critical differences, groups them, and summarizes them in an evaluation format.

decide.title: Share the decision report
decide.description: Your team sees why an offer is stronger through the same standard.

use_cases.title: Use the same evaluation standard across 10 lines.
use_cases.description: Versus AI brings quote comparison and policy reading workflows into a shared decision format across insurance products.

request.title: Let’s review the decision flow using your own quote files.
request.description: In the first conversation, we clarify product fit and set up a controlled demo flow using real files.
